why_template_only: The current runner feeds the same shared evidence to A and B. A true context-saving test needs variant-specific evidence so A can receive broad context while B receives a compact evidence receipt.

A.name: broad_context
A.evidence_shape: Full documents, full logs, and original human request.
A.purpose: Baseline for cost and quality with broad context.

B.name: compact_receipt
B.evidence_shape: Evidence Receipt plus minimum SACP task contract and paths to full logs.
B.purpose: Candidate route for reduced context and lower total cost.

pass_rule.retry_rule: B retries must be less than or equal to A retries when measured.

claim_boundary.safe: This template defines the future shape of a context-saving benchmark.
claim_boundary.unsafe: This template proves SACP or task packets save tokens.
